front_door.description: Recessed under a tall white round-arched porch with a glazed fanlight; dark-coloured door; short path behind a low front wall with a small step at the threshold.

access_notes: Narrow frontage with small front garden and low wall.
Short path from pavement; small threshold step; possible lower-ground/basement lightwell behind the front wall.
Residents’ parking bays along the kerb.
Parking/permit signpost on pavement near the frontage.
Telecom/utility cabinet on pavement nearby (painted green, marked “15”).
Street lighting column and a utility/telegraph pole close by on the pavement.
No hydrant marker or standpipe visible.
obstacles: Street lighting column/telegraph pole on pavement.
rear_access_note: Rear garden appears to back onto other gardens with no visible rear alley or side passage for this mid-terrace plot (from satellite view).
parking: Kerbside on Deerbrook Road in residents’ bays directly outside or opposite, subject to available space on this single-carriageway residential street.
